verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships Bionic, a first-party agent that creates and edits documents, takes voice input, and handles 'advanced agentic tasks'. Its chat can also use installed MCP tools with local models. A hands-on user reports Bionic 'works great', though another user hit an infinite loop with MCP tool use. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what tasks Bionic can perform and how delegation works, clarity on whether Bionic is built into LM Studio or a separate app, and reliability evidence beyond first impressions (unclear working directory, model preload/unload gaps, MCP loop failure).
